description: Reference text and links of the fixed page sections (everything outside the price list and estimate, which have their own tests). Taken from the live site on 14 Nov 2026. Header and About must be identical in both versions. The hero differs since the hero-integration phase (Nov 2026): Astro has the new layout and a "Call us" button; the single-file rollback copy keeps the old hero. Contact and footer differ on purpose: the Astro version shows the full confirmed business details added in Phase 2 (SEO), already reviewed and merged; the single-file site still has the shorter text. Change this file only in the same pull request that deliberately changes the page text. Since 17 Nov 2026 the header is per version too: the Astro site has no WhatsApp button in the header (one Enquire button with WhatsApp or call sits in the hero and Contact).
